resolution.question: Does French Ambassador Jean-Pierre Dupont deliver the protest note to the German Foreign Office before the ultimatum expires on July 28, 1914?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Ambassador Dupont actually delivered the protest note to the German Foreign Office before the ultimatum expires on July 28, 1914 (i.e., before 1914-07-28T23:59:00+01:00). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
